verdict.rationale: No evidence shows Aircall forwarding the business number to an external cell phone. The IVR with business-hours scheduling (aircall-docs-20) routes calls to teams inside Aircall, which is an adjacent feature. The overflow and meeting tutorials (aircall-docs-7, aircall-docs-9) are developer API building blocks, not a documented forwarding capability. After-hours AI agents (aircall-docs-24) answer calls rather than forward them, so none of these earn credit.
